Scenario exploration under stated rules; scenario projections, not forecasts. Shares are shares of parameter sets, not probabilities of real outcomes.

E3 runs were produced by the frozen model (produced_by_fingerprint). The current model.py (model_fingerprint) adds an approval switch that is off by default; with it off, outputs are bit-identical to the frozen model (04 §9).

In the frozen pathways, PW4 has a standing local line from the start and PW5 adds one automatically after two years, with no approval step; PW2 must pass a Prop L amendment. The "-approval" variant puts PW4/PW5 through the same approval chain as PW2.
PW1 ends in a hypothetical Director reallocation branch (probability and amount are assumptions).

Pressure, a named owner and crew capacity act in the model only through the start probability or a cap; their small sensitivity reflects the model having no other channel for them, not their real-world importance.
